description: 303 Voice Core: the diode ladder filter, articulation envelopes, accent path and amplifier of a TB-303, taking its audio from an oscillator

params.text: Sets the resonance of the ladder, 0 to 100%
Extends the resonance past what the original circuit reaches, marked STOCK and HIGH
Sets the drive into the filter, -60dB to 36dB; fully down mutes the input
Restores the bass the ladder loses at high resonance, 0 to 100%
Attenuverts the exponential cutoff CV input
Attenuverts the linear filter FM input; at full each volt moves the cutoff by 200Hz
Scales how far the filter envelope moves the cutoff, up to six octaves; raising it opens the attack further and closes the tail sooner
Sets the decay of the filter envelope on unaccented notes, 30ms to 3 seconds
Sets the decay of the filter envelope on accented notes, 30ms to 3 seconds
Sets how much an accent lifts both the filter sweep and the amplifier
Sets the decay and sustain of the amplifier envelope
Scales the amplifier control, whether it arrives at the VCA CV input or comes from the internal envelope
Chooses the speed of the accent's resonant sweep, or turns it off, marked O, F, N and S

inputs.text: The audio to be filtered; the channel count of this jack alone sets the module's polyphony
Moves the cutoff, one octave per volt
Moves the cutoff exponentially, scaled by its attenuverter
Modulates the cutoff in Hz, AC-coupled so a steady offset is removed
Modulates the resonance, scaled by its attenuverter
Opens the articulation envelopes; the filter envelope produces nothing until this is patched
Marks a note as accented, lifting the filter sweep and the amplifier
Replaces the internal amplifier envelope with a control of your own, 10V for full

outputs.text: The filtered audio, taken before the amplifier
The filtered audio through the amplifier

notes: the filter envelope produces nothing until a gate is patched; without one the cutoff stays where the knob and the CV inputs put it
polyphony follows the channel count of the audio input alone, so a polyphonic gate or pitch on its own leaves the module mono
menu: Oversampling — chooses 2x or 4x oversampling of the filter and amplifier
Articulation — chooses between TB-303 and Devil Fish envelope behaviour
